Consent.Text00: Client Log Collection Consent Request for Game Optimization\n\n
Consent.Text01: In order to improve the performance of the game and investigate specific issues that could occur,\n
Consent.Text02: we would like to collect additional information about your PC environment.\n\n
Consent.Text03: We would like to collect information about your operating system, CPU, memory, and shader use.\n
Consent.Text04: In addition, we would like to also collect details about your current game status and account used.\n
Consent.Text05: This includes: frames per second, current map information, world, level\n
Consent.Text06: and job status of your character.\n
Consent.Text07: This information will only be used to help our teams investigate\n
Consent.Text08: when specific issues occur in your client.\n\n
Consent.Text09: Collecting this data should not cause any latency issues\n
Consent.Text10: or otherwise interfere with your normal game play.\n\n
Consent.Text11: Do you wish to consent to this data collection?\n
Consent.Text12: (You may change this selection anytime through the in-game Options menu.)
